Method of Attack: The attackers copied the widely-used NPM library colors and included a 3.6MB Python file containing malicious code to the original 40KB JavaScript repository. This Python file was hidden using Hyperion obfuscation. The package uses the preinstall and postinstall hooks to ensure Python and necessary Python dependencies are installed, then executes the Python-based malware via JavaScript-based system commands.
Attack Vector: The package impersonates the widely used 'colors' package on NPM, attempting to trick users into downloading and executing the malicious Python code.
Indicators of Compromise: The NPM package contains a link to a GitHub repository that belongs to a throwaway user account called 'seasonal-circulation.'
The language distribution within the repository is 81% Python in a supposedly JavaScript library.
The malicious code is buried in the lib/custom/styles.py file.
The package uses install hooks to install Python dependencies and executes Python-based malware using JavaScript-based system commands.
